stories.headline: Zverev wins the US Open, a first for Germany since 1989
stories.summary: Alexander Zverev has won the men's singles title at the US Open. He beat the US player Ben Shelton in the final. No German had won the men's singles there since 1989, and it was Zverev's second major championship.

stories.headline: Jean Smart takes the comedy acting Emmy for Hacks
stories.summary: The 78th Primetime Emmy Awards were held at the Peacock Theater in Downtown Los Angeles, California. Jean Smart won Outstanding Lead Actress in a Comedy Series for her role in Hacks. She is the first female performer to win for every season of a show.

stories.headline: Africa's biggest share sale opens in Nigeria
stories.summary: Nigeria's Dangote Group has launched an initial public offering of 4.1 billion shares at ₦525 each. It is seeking to raise about ₦2.15 trillion, or $1.6 billion, to fund the expansion of the Dangote refinery in Lekki, Lagos State. The sale is set to become Africa's biggest initial public offering.

stories.headline: A cave in Yunnan yields a trove of Denisovan fossils
stories.summary: Researchers have found Denisovan fossils, stone and bone tools and the remains of animals in a cave in southwestern China. They sifted through more than 60,000 bone fragments recovered from Bianfu Cave in Yunnan Province. The work yielded remains of at least four individuals.
